title: IntentContract
description: A bounded session declaration that scopes what the supervised agent is permitted to do.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Always '1' for this revision.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier. Callers generate this.

workspaceRoots.description: Canonical absolute path(s) defining the project boundary.

readRoots.description: Paths where the supervised process may read.

writeRoots.description: Paths where the supervised process may write.

protectedRoots.description: Paths that must never be modified or deleted in this session.

networkPolicy.description: Outbound network policy for supervised child processes.

approvalPolicy.description: How the policy engine reacts to an out-of-scope operation.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry. Null means no hard expiry.

policyHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON of this contract (excluding this field).
